title: Germany: NRW, Hessen, Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Bremen, SH, RLP coverage gap
description: Coverage-gap pass over western and northern Germany (Nordrhein-Westfalen, Hessen, Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Bremen, Schleswig-Holstein, Rheinland-Pfalz): indoor climbing gyms with a bouldering offering missing from Bouldeer, chains first, then big metros. Research 2026-10-06.
